jurisdiction.name: Guyana
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: Constitution of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana (1980). Final appellate court: Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ).

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the subdivision of land into strata lots and for related matters.
primaryActs.summary: Strata regime for Guyana. Section 8 establishes the body corporate; section 18 the insurance trust.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the registration of title to land in Guyana.
primaryActs.summary: Governs land registration. Section 11 establishes the priority of registered interests.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to regulate the rent of certain dwelling-houses.
primaryActs.summary: Caps residential rent for older tenancies. Section 5 sets the dispute path.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to make provision for the cultivation, marketing and sale of paddy and rice.
primaryActs.summary: Agri-tenure relevance for rice-darn tenancies along the Essequibo Coast.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to define the time within which actions may be brought in respect of land.
primaryActs.summary: Codifies the limitation periods for adverse possession and other land claims.

leadingCases.headnote: Sinking-fund contributions under the Strata Title Act must be segregated from operating funds; commingling is a breach of s.18.

proceduralRules.tribunalOrCourt: Supreme Court of Judicature of Guyana
proceduralRules.title: Rules of the Supreme Court

remedies.label: Commingled Funds Challenge
remedies.description: Action to compel segregation of sinking-fund and operating funds under the Strata Title Act s.18.
